\begin{bankq}[id=SI11-P2-MATH-S1-Q02, source={Score-I - Test 11 (27 Feb 2022)}, paper=2, qno=2, type=multi, subtopic={Tangents}, answer={A,D}, answer_src=key, difficulty=7, diff_parts={K2 S3 I1 C1 F1}, diff_note={concepts: hyperbola with tangent, normal conditions and area of a triangle | steps: tangent through (1,0) fixes point P; normal with equal intercepts has slope -1; relations among a b; eccentricity; area; check}, also_in={JEE Advanced (2021 Series) - Test 02 (04 Feb 2021) P2 Q2}]
Let $a$ and $b$ be positive real numbers such that $a>1$ and $b<a$. Let $P$ be a point in the first quadrant that lies on the hyperbola $\dfrac{x^2}{a^2}-\dfrac{y^2}{b^2}=1$. Suppose the tangent to the hyperbola at $P$ passes through the point $(1,0)$, and suppose the normal to the hyperbola at $P$ cuts off equal intercepts on the coordinate axes. Let $\Delta$ denote the area of the triangle formed by the tangent at $P$, the normal at $P$ and the $x$-axis. If $e$ denotes the eccentricity of the hyperbola, then which of the following statements is/are TRUE ?
\begin{qoptions}
\opt{A}{$1<e<\sqrt2$}
\opt{B}{$\sqrt2<e<2$}
\opt{C}{$\Delta=a^4$}
\opt{D}{$\Delta=b^4$}
\end{qoptions}
\end{bankq}
